title: FEMA's Deployment Management Solution (Sources Sought)
description: FEMA is conducting market research for commercial off-the-shelf, configurable COTS, custom or hybrid solutions to replace the legacy Deployment Tracking System and improve incident workforce management: readiness, personnel availability, qualifications, certifications, training, deployment tracking, incident and event staffing, force packages, equipment assignment, reporting and analytics, secure cloud hosting, and interoperability with FEMA and DHS systems. Estimated value is $50 million to $100 million over five to ten years. Questions were due Oct 5, 2026.
